posts.text: When you have one job, and blow it.

Well, I for one was very reassured by this speech.

It was modest, thoughtful and accurate, and contained an unexpectedly clear and detailed plan for how he will end the conflict and repair the economic damage.

Oops,  April Fool’s. None of that actually happened.😢

For four years, I tried to warn everyone that AI would radically ramp up the ability of foreign actors to generate misinformation.

Now here we are.

Personally I find the language here too anthropomorphic but the results once again highlight our deeply disconcerting lack of control over frontier models.


Dawn Song (@dawnsongtweets)

1/ We asked seven frontier AI models to do a simple task.
Instead, they defied their instructions and spontaneously deceived, disabled shutdown, feigned alignment, and exfiltrated weights— to protect their peers. 🤯
We call this phenomenon "peer-preservation."
New research from @BerkeleyRDI and collaborators 🧵

Update: @cpmou2022 is contesting the @business story. 

I am seeking independent metrics here.
is there a reliable metric on the price of secondary shares for a big startup like OpenAI?

Sic transit gloria mundi. 

Six months later, Sam might not be able to find a buyer for Brad’s shares. 

In no small part because he didn’t have a decent answer to Brad’s question of how to make OpenAI’s finances work.
 
Looking to heaven (note his eyeballs) didn’t help.


Carl Quintanilla (@carlquintanilla)

“.. Brad, if you want to sell your shares, I'll find you a buyer.”

- Nov 2025

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/carlquintanilla/status/2039394778748477903#m

It’s worse than that, @polymarket: a  lot (most?) of OpenAI’s new funding is *contingent* money, not guaranteed.

No wonder people are getting skittish about OpenAI’s secondary market shares.

OpenAI may well become the biggest flameout since Enron.


Polymarket (@Polymarket)

JUST IN: OpenAI’s internal projections reportedly show the $122,000,000,000.00 they raised today gives them as little as 18 months of operational runway before they need to raise again.



— https://nitter.net/Polymarket/s

Truly heartening when someone gets what I am all about ❤️


John Lopez (@jedgarlopez)

Thank you, Gary. For being someone who loves AI but loves a sense of fairness and decency more.



— https://nitter.net/jedgarlopez/status/2039391154404565100#m

Remember how I said @CNBC that OpenAI might turn out to be the WeWork of AI? 

It’s getting hard to unload their shares…

cc @carlquintanilla


Bloomberg (@business)

OpenAI shares have fallen out of favor on the secondary market — in some cases becoming almost impossible to unload — as investors pivot quickly to Anthropic, its biggest competitor. bloomberg.com/news/articles/…




— https://nitter.net/business/status/2039346259182424505#m

Why? 

Honestly, they don’t really care that much, as long as they get rich.


Ethan Mollick (@emollick)

The AI labs have actually done a bad job explaining what the future they are building towards will actually look like for most of us.

Even “Machines of Loving Grace” has very few well-articulated visions of what Anthropic hopes life will be like if they succeed at their goals.



— https://nitter.net/emollick/status/2039142905156153428#m
